Polyglyceryl-10 esters @12/@13 and Charcoal Powder @9 are not cleansing routes or buffers (C3). Counter-signals (guar @8, Nigella oil @5) do not move the convention.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High by the Section 5 rich-architecture anchor: W-RICH under its E3 reading for conditioning (prominent payload lipid Nigella Sativa Seed Oil @5 converging with prominent cationic Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @8); C2 itself is not met (no pearlizing/fatty route, no listed humectant; Polyglycerin-10 is not on the closed C2 list). Counter-signal: only one lipid and one polymer in a strong ALS chassis with charcoal; the plain 'one meaningful system plus light routes' reading gives moderate, the realistic neighbor.
